capabilities: generate stereo brown noise with independent left and right channels
shape the sound with a low-pass filter and bass boost
set a sleep timer with a gentle fade-out
control playback from ribbon, status bar and commands with hotkeys
extras: The README contains an unresolved Git merge-conflict marker (<<<<<<< Updated upstream / >>>>>>> Stashed changes) around the license section. Licensing: GNU AGPL v3 or later, free for personal and noncommercial use; commercial use needs the author's permission. The README states the sound is generated locally with no network connection and no files outside its own settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play ambient sound for focus or sleep without leaving the app or using external files.
summary: Brown-noise generator that plays stereo brown noise for focus and sleep, with a low-pass filter, bass boost and a fading sleep timer.
